about: NOAA Tides & Currents (CO-OPS): find tide, current and observation stations and fetch tide predictions, water levels, weather, current predictions, datums, harmonic constituents, sea level trends and storm surge alerts through NOAA's public metadata and data APIs.

commands.summary: Search tide prediction stations by name (e.g. 'Boston'); returns station IDs, state, region and coordinates

params.name: q
params.description: Station or place name to search for

commands.summary: List all CO-OPS stations offering a given product type (water levels, met, currents, current predictions, datums, harmonic constituents, etc.)

params.name: expand
params.description: Comma-separated sub-resources to inline, e.g. 'products,sensors,notices,floodlevels,datums'. Omit for a compact list.

commands.summary: Get metadata for one station by ID (name, location, timezone, flags) with optional expanded products, datums, details, notices, benchmarks

params.name: expand
params.description: Comma-separated sub-resources to inline: products, datums, disclaimers, notices, details, benchmarks, sensors, floodlevels

commands.summary: Get tidal datums for a station (MLLW, MHHW, MSL, NAVD88 etc.) plus LAT/HAT and record min/max
List a station's sensors (water level, barometer, wind, temperature...) with status and elevation
Get tidal harmonic constituents (M2, S2, K1...) for a station: amplitude, phase, speed
List the stations nearest to a given station, with distance and station type
Get tide prediction offsets for a station (reference vs. subordinate, time/height offsets to its reference station)
Get tide predictions for a station: high/low times and heights or a regular time series, for a date or date range

params.name: date
params.description: Relative date: today, latest or recent. Use this OR begin_date/end_date OR range.

params.name: range
params.description: Number of hours (used with begin_date or end_date, or alone for the last N hours)

params.name: interval
params.description: hilo = high/low tides only; h = hourly; or minutes

params.name: time_zone
params.description: gmt, lst (local standard) or lst_ldt (local with daylight saving)

commands.summary: Get observed data for a station: water levels, air/water temperature, wind, air pressure, humidity, visibility, conductivity, salinity, air gap

params.name: product
params.description: Data product. Not every station offers every product; check get-station-sensors or get-data-inventory first.

params.name: date
params.description: Relative date: today, latest or recent (last 72h). Use this OR begin_date/end_date OR range.

params.name: range
params.description: Number of hours (with begin_date/end_date, or alone for the last N hours)

params.name: datum
params.description: Vertical datum (required for water level products, ignored otherwise)

params.name: interval
params.description: Set to h for hourly met data (default is 6-minute)

commands.summary: Get tidal current predictions for a current station: max flood/ebb and slack times and speeds, or a time series

params.name: station
params.description: Current prediction station ID (find via list-stations --type currentpredictions)

params.name: date
params.description: Relative date: today, latest or recent. Use this OR begin_date/end_date OR range.

params.name: interval
params.description: MAX_SLACK = max flood/ebb and slack events only; or minutes for a time series

params.name: bin
params.description: Depth bin number (omit for the station's default bin)

commands.summary: Browse tide prediction geographic groups: top-level regions (lvl=4), states (lvl=5), or children of a parent group

params.name: parent
params.description: Parent geoGroupId to list its sub-groups (e.g. 1743 = U.S. West Coast)

commands.summary: List the sub-areas and tide prediction stations inside a geographic group (e.g. a state such as 1403 = Massachusetts)
Get the full hierarchy of current prediction regions and their stations (coast > state > area > station with bin)
List PORTS (Physical Oceanographic Real-Time System) stations with the sensors each provides
Get a station's data inventory: which parameters it has measured and over what date ranges
List relative sea level trends (inches/decade, period of record) for all US or global stations, or one station
Download a station's monthly mean sea level trend data as CSV (year, month, monthly MSL, linear trend, confidence bounds)
List active storm surge / coastal inundation events (storm name, type, analysis, links)
List recent NOAA Tides & Currents news posts
